verdict.rationale: Bento's own site claims releases are scored against production history offline and in CI, which covers the core of running offline evaluations on production-derived data. Nothing documents curating datasets from traces: no selecting, labeling, versioning or managing an eval dataset, and no docs on how offline evals are configured or run. Missing for 10: explicit dataset curation from production traces (selection, labeling, versioning), documentation of offline eval setup and execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: Every release scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic. Catches regressions before users do.
The nudge ships in shadow mode, is scored against the outcome it was meant to fix
